cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:d3.title: Automotive Technician
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:d3.description: Primary Role Summary The Automotive Technician is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining customer vehicles safely, efficiently, and in accordance with manufacturer and company standards. The Technician plays a critical role in delivering quality repairs, identifying additional service opportunities, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience. The Automotive Technician serves as the technical expert within the shop, providing accurate inspections, quality workmanship, and professional recommendations that support customer safety, vehicle reliability, and company profitability. Key Responsibilities 1. Vehicle Diagnostics & Repair Perform vehicle inspections and diagnostic testing. Identify mechanical, electrical, drivability, and performance issues. Diagnose root causes and recommend corrective actions. Perform repairs according to manufacturer specifications and company standards. Complete maintenance services including brakes, tires, alignments, oil changes, suspension, batteries, and other vehicle systems. Verify repairs through testing and quality control procedures. 2. Inspection & Customer Recommendations Perform comprehensive vehicle inspections. Identify maintenance and repair opportunities. Document inspection findings accurately. Communicate repair recommendations clearly to Service Advisors. Support customer safety and preventative maintenance programs. Assist in maximizing vehicle reliability and customer satisfaction. 3. Productivity & Workflow Management Maintain efficient work habits and productivity levels. Complete assigned work within established labor times. Manage workflow and prioritize assignments effectively. Support overall shop throughput and scheduling objectives. Minimize delays and operational bottlenecks. 4. Quality Control & Workmanship Ensure repairs are completed correctly the first time. Follow shop quality control procedures. Conduct final inspections and testing prior to vehicle release. Minimize comeback repairs and warranty work. Maintain high standards of workmanship and professionalism. 5. Safety, Equipment & Facility Care Follow OSHA, EPA, and company safety requirements. Utilize tools, lifts, and diagnostic equipment properly. Maintain a clean and organized work area. Properly handle and dispose of hazardous materials. Report damaged equipment and safety concerns immediately. Protect customer vehicles and company assets. 6. Documentation & Communication Complete repair order notes accurately and thoroughly. Document diagnostic findings, repairs performed, and recommendations. Communicate effectively with Service Advisors and management. Maintain accurate labor and time records. Participate in production meetings and training activities. 7. Continuous Improvement & Training Stay current with automotive technology and repair procedures. Participate in technical training and certification programs. Develop advanced diagnostic and repair skills. Support mentorship and knowledge sharing within the shop. Promote a culture of professionalism and continuous improvement.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0b824bb1-3ccc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in United States. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led bus

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4411b165-18b0-.title: Design & Engineering Coordinator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4411b165-18b0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Design & Engineering Coordinator based in the United States. This role supports senior design and engineering leadership across a concurrent, multi-project portfolio. You will coordinate design reviews, document control, standards governance, vendor processes, and project workflows. The position requires hands-on ownership of drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, compliance trackers, and review documentation. You will help keep multidisciplinary teams aligned, ensuring deliverables, comments, and action items move forward on schedule. The role combines technical project coordination with executive support in a fast-paced, detail-driven environment. Your work will directly improve document accuracy, review efficiency, communication, and project execution across multiple teams and time zones. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, technically fluent, and comfortable driving follow-through without constant supervision. Maintain project document structures, file naming conventions, revision controls, access permissions, and confidentiality requirements across SharePoint and project management platforms. Log, distribute, and track drawing sets, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and design review comments, ensuring receipt, response, and closure are properly documented. Issue and archive transmittals and maintain current-revision registers to prevent teams from working with superseded documentation. Track design review cycles against stage-gate milestones and proactively identify slipping deliverables before they affect project schedules. Maintain compliance and deviation logs, including OPR versus BOD tracking, RFI logs, and bid comparison matrices. Assemble internal and tenant-facing review packages, including consolidated comment logs and response tracking. Coordinate multidisciplinary and multi-time-zone design reviews, workshops, project kickoffs, and knowledge-transfer sessions. Prepare meeting agendas, capture accurate minutes, and maintain action registers with clearly assigned owners and deadlines. Drive action items through completion and escalate stalled deliverables or unresolved issues when necessary. Support RFP and bid processes through distribution, bidder Q&A tracking, proposal intake, and comparison workbook preparation. Onboard consultants and vendors to document platforms, file structures, and naming standards. Maintain consultant contact registers, scopes of work, design team organization charts, and related project information. Track candidate pipelines and interview scheduling for design and engineering positions. Maintain, update, and version-control design standards, checklists, and templates, ensuring current materials are published and accessible to project teams. Manage complex calendars across multiple time zones, including travel arrangements and itinerary coordination. Prepare presentations, expense reports, correspondence, and other materials required by design and engineering leadership. Within the first 90 days, establish consistent document structures, accurate action registers, reliable revision control, and a well-organized executive review queue across active projects. Requirements: 5+ years of experience supporting engineering, architecture, construction, data center development, or similar technical project teams. Demonstrated experience with document control on active design or construction projects. Working knowledge of drawing sets, specification sections, submittal and RFI workflows, and design-phase deliverables such as SD, DD, CD, and IFC. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. Experience with at least one AEC or construction technology platform, such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360, Newforma, Sitetracker, Bluebeam Revu, or an equivalent solution. Exceptional organizational skill

jobgether-jobgether:lever:dc4f66fe-933e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Spain. As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead complex, high-impact engineering programs that span multiple teams, systems, and technical domains. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, shaping program strategy and setting a high standard for execution across the organization. The role sits at the intersection of technical depth, strategic planning, and hands-on delivery, requiring you to work closely with engineers and product leaders. You will own scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs while ensuring critical initiatives remain on track. You will act as a trusted coordination point across Engineering, Product, Design, Security, and go-to-market teams. Your ability to bring clarity to ambiguity and communicate program health effectively will give technical and executive leadership the visibility needed to make informed decisions. This is an opportunity to influence how complex engineering work gets delivered in a highly technical, AI-focused environment. Own complex engineering programs end to end, from initial definition and cross-functional planning through delivery, iteration, and closeout. Define and manage program scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, risks, and critical deliverables across teams that may not share direct reporting lines. Drive cross-functional trade-offs and ensure key decisions are documented clearly, with accountability maintained throughout execution. Work closely with engineers and product managers to understand technical details and influence architectural, sequencing, and interface decisions where appropriate. Serve as the central coordination point across Engineering, Product, Design, Security, and go-to-market functions. Establish and maintain an effective operating cadence, providing clear and concise updates on program health, risks, dependencies, decisions, and trade-offs. Communicate effectively with technical teams, executive leadership, and customer-facing stakeholders, adapting the level of detail to each audience. Identify delivery risks and blockers early, develop mitigation strategies, and drive resolution across organizational boundaries. Provide leadership with the visibility required to understand program progress, make informed decisions, and steer high-priority initiatives. Improve engineering productivity through lightweight processes, effective tooling, and AI-native approaches that increase execution efficiency without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy. Continuously evaluate program practices and remove processes that no longer add value while maintaining appropriate rigor and accountability. Requirements: 7+ years of experience in technical program management, including ownership of complex, multi-team engineering programs where no single team was responsible for the complete outcome. Strong technical intuition and the ability to understand engineering design documents, identify unstated assumptions, challenge technical decisions constructively, and discuss sequencing with senior engineers. Proven track record of delivering complex initiatives at scale, including ownership of externally committed milestones such as general availability launches, major releases, or regulated enterprise deadlines. Demonstrated ability to influence teams and stakeholders without direct authority, establish direction with minimal oversight, and make progress despite ambiguity or competing priorities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, product managers, executives, and customer-facing stakeholders. Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple dependencies, risks, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously. Sound judgment around process, knowing when structure and rigor are necessary and

todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:72bc3d.title: Senior Creative Designer
todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:72bc3d.description: About TodayTix Group: TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment. Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world. In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement. Life at TodayTix Group We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next. New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development. Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply. About the Role: We're looking for a bold, established, highly craft-focused Senior Creative Designer to join our Creative Studio and play a pivotal role in continuing to evolve the TodayTix brand. Your work will shape brand perception, audience engagement, and marketing effectiveness, ensuring a cohesive and compelling brand presence across all channels. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, high-growth, and collaborative environment and are passionate about brand storytelling, design craft, and creative innovation, we'd love to hear from you! Please note: This is a full-time and qualified candidates must be based in the greater London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2days per week in the office, while also offering flexibility for employees to choose where they work for the rest of the week. Curious about the kind of work we do? Here's a look inside our world.

turnriver-turn-river:ashbyhq:b097f39e-61.description: ABOUT THE JOB A Turn/River portfolio company is seeking a strategic, data-driven Director of Digital Performance Marketing to lead the performance marketing strategy across SEO, SEM, CRO, and AI search — including Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and other AI/LLM-driven discovery channels. This role will own both earned and paid media performance, with a strong emphasis on organic search, paid search, and AI-powered answer engines (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot) as core growth engines, while using modern conversion rate optimization techniques, tools, and strategies. As search shifts toward zero-click and AI-generated answers, the ideal candidate is a hands-on performance marketing leader who can build strategy, lead execution, optimize investment, and deliver measurable pipeline and revenue impact — regardless of where discovery happens. YOUR ROLE The Director, Digital Performance Marketing will define and lead the digital acquisition strategy across key channels, with primary ownership of Paid Search, Organic Search, AI Search / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Conversion Optimization. This leader will be responsible for building a modern, full-funnel performance engine that competes for visibility not only in traditional search results but also in AI Overviews, chat-based answer engines, and other zero-click surfaces — increasing qualified traffic, improving conversion efficiency, and driving scalable growth across the business. This role requires a strong operator who combines strategic thinking with analytical rigor, deep search and AI-search expertise, and the ability to lead cross-functional execution across content, web, analytics, creative, and campaign teams. The position is ideal for a performance marketer who is equally comfortable setting vision, managing large budgets, staying ahead of the fast-evolving AI search landscape, and getting into the details of optimization. YOUR IMPACT SEARCH STRATEGY AND CHANNEL LEADERSHIP - Own the overall digital performance marketing strategy across SEO, SEM, AI search/AEO, display, and paid social, with SEO, SEM, and AI search serving as the primary focus areas. - Build and evolve a comprehensive search strategy spanning technical SEO, on-page optimization, content-driven SEO, paid search campaign architecture, bidding strategy, keyword portfolio management, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) tactics for AI Overviews and other LLM-powered answer engines. - Lead full-funnel acquisition planning across TOFU, MOFU, and BOFU motions, ensuring channel investment aligns to business goals, audience intent, and conversion opportunities. - Develop integrated channel strategies that connect earned and paid media to improve visibility, traffic quality, conversion rates, and pipeline generation. - Drive a test-and-learn culture across messaging, targeting, bidding, landing pages, audience segmentation, and creative. - Track the ongoing shift toward zero-click search and AI-generated answers, evolving channel strategy and success metrics to reflect how buyers now discover, evaluate, and engage with content across both traditional and AI-powered search experiences. AI SEARCH, ANSWER ENGINE OPTIMIZATION (AEO) & LLM VISIBILITY - Own the company’s AI search strategy, including Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), to maximize brand visibility, citation, and share of voice across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and other LLM-powered answer engines. - Build structured, entity-rich, machine-readable content — including schema markup, structured data, and clear source attribution — that increases the likelihood of being cited, quoted, or summarized in AI-generated answers. - Define and track AI search performance using metrics such as citation rate, mention rate, prompt-level share of voice, sentiment, and AI-referral traffic, leveraging platforms such as Profound,
